dataset.name: Sap flow and Dendrometer Raw Data from 10-2015 to 06-2016 at the Forest Service TRACE project in Sabana, PR
description: This dataset contains sap flow and dendrometer data from eight different over story trees located at the Forest Service TRACE project at Sabana, Puerto Rico (PR-Sab). Data was collected over the time period of 2015-10-07 to 2016-06-10. Two data files are included in the attached zip file in CSV format, Sab_DEN_Raw_CR1000_20160629.csv and Sab_SAP_Raw_CR1000_20160629.csv. Additionally, two metadata files are included in Excel format (Data_Column_Description_v1_PR-Sab_20160629.xlsx, which describes the formatting of datasets, and File_Submission_Metadata_v1_PR-Sab_20160707.xlsx, which includes details of both data files). The data set is unprocessed and includes missing data during periods prior to sensor installation and poor data during periods of sensor failure.
This dataset was originally published on the NGEE Tropics Archive and is being mirrored on ESS-DIVE for long-term archival

spatialCoverage.description: Site Name: Sabana. Site ID: PR-Sab. Located in Puerto Rico. The Sabana Field Research Station is in the Rio Sabana watershed, contains a monitoring station on the Rio Sabana, and is a short drive from the Bisley Long-term Ecological Research watersheds. (CZO website). The TRACE experiment (http://forestwarming.org) is located at Sabana. For more information on this site, visit: http://criticalzone.org/luquillo/infrastructure/field-area/sabana-field-station1/#settingResearch Site contact(s): (Grizelle González <ggonzalez@fs.fed.us>)
